title: Residents petition Greystar for indoor air-quality testing at Forty55 Lofts
subject: greystar
summary: Petition started by resident Wendy K. alleges residents became seriously ill from formaldehyde and other indoor toxins above health guidelines, that requests for testing and remediation were ignored, that residents were forced to take legal action, and that Greystar continues to rent untested units. It asks that Greystar be required to test and confirm units are habitable; it had 108 signatures when reviewed.

title: Tenant alleges management misstated lease-end terms and is holding them two extra months
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management gave written instructions about ending the lease that conflicted with the lease, and is now requiring two additional months of tenancy; reviewer says escalations to Greystar went unanswered.

title: Senior community resident alleges intimidation and refusal to address tenant harassment
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer at a 55+ community alleges management staff were aggressive and intimidating toward residents who complained, practiced favoritism, and said they would not intervene in tenant-on-tenant harassment.

title: 18-year resident alleges declining service, fire-alarm errors and understaffed maintenance
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges conditions declined after Greystar took over, including a misdirected fire-alarm response that nearly led the fire department to break down their door, slow snow removal, a fitness fee despite broken equipment, a pool closed most of summer 2023, and one maintenance worker for 232+ units.

title: Tenant alleges $2,000 deposit not returned within state-law deadline
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a $2,000 security deposit was still unreturned three months after move-out, beyond the state-law deadline, and that corporate phone lines led only to voicemail; reviewer describes the units as unsafe and unhealthy.

title: New tenant alleges unaddressed roach infestation at move-in
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a unit managed by Greystar was filthy and roach-infested at move-in in November 2023 and that the infestation remained unresolved weeks later, citing an Arizona statute and stating an intent to hire a lawyer.

title: Tenant alleges refund reversed after move-out and early-morning unannounced entry attempts
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that a deposit refund confirmed in writing after move-out was later recast as a balance owed, that all mailboxes used a common key, and that maintenance tried to enter the unit as early as 6 a.m. and on weekends without work orders.

title: Student alleges $2,005 pre-lease payment not refunded
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer, a college student, alleges they were required to pay a month's rent before receiving any lease terms on a promise of a full refund if unsatisfied, and that requests for that refund went unanswered.

title: Tenant alleges malfunctioning smoke/fire alarm and unanswered emergency line
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a smoke/fire alarm in their unit kept malfunctioning without repair and that the after-hours emergency number rang without answer.

title: Tenant alleges roach-infested unit at move-in and repairs tied to steep rent hikes
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the apartment was infested with cockroaches at move-in, upper floors had soft, patched flooring, and leaks between units were common. Reviewer alleges repairs were being made mainly in units whose rent had risen more than 30% in two years, and that online rent payment carried fees.

title: Tenant alleges repeated ceiling leaks, mildew painted over and roach infestation
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges extensive water damage, with water coming through the kitchen ceiling three times in three years and a ruined light fixture left unreplaced for 10 months, and that repairs involved painting over mildew and nailing plywood over rotting boards. Reviewer also reports an uncontrolled German cockroach infestation.

title: Tenant alleges roaches, safety problems and move-out fees despite spotless unit
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges no meaningful response to cockroaches, multiple fires on the property, drug activity and squatters without a management response, a valet trash fee for unreliable pickup, and move-out fees despite leaving the unit spotless after completing the lease.

title: Tenant alleges unsanitary conditions and lack of ADA access alongside rising fees
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges hallways often had animal waste, dumpsters routinely overflowed, and the property lacks elevators and adequate accessible parking, while Greystar continued raising rent and adding fees.

title: Former tenant alleges withheld deposit, double-rent holdover and surprise charge two years later
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges they were not allowed to end the lease on time and were charged an extra month at double rent, the deposit was withheld without an itemized list, and a new $200 repair charge was raised two years after move-out. Reviewer says staff would not provide a move-out checklist or walk-through.

title: Tenant alleges failed toilet repair led to mold and deposit was kept
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a toilet that broke again after repair was never fixed, leading to mold discovered at move-out, and that the full deposit was withheld although the damage stemmed from the repairs. Reviewer also reports unexplained rent increases.

title: Student tenants allege months without dishwasher, termites and coercive move-out cleaning charge
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges repair requests were ignored for months, including no dishwasher for half the lease, and recurring termites were never fully treated. Reviewer alleges management threatened to keep the whole security deposit unless tenants paid for a deep clean, which the reviewer believes is unlawful.

title: Tenant alleges unrepaired bedroom leak for months and 30% rent increase
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges rain caused major bedroom leaks beginning in January that remained unrepaired months later with no rent abatement despite repeated calls and emails, followed by a 30% rent increase at renewal.

title: Long-time tenant alleges legal threats over late rent after Greystar takeover
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after Greystar took over from a smaller manager, being even two hours late on rent brings a late fee and threats of legal action within days, maintenance became slow, and the office never answers the phone.

title: Tenant alleges eviction attempt over landlord's own accounting error and flooding from new roofs
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management tried to evict them for nonpayment due to an accounting error on management's side, that newly replaced roofs leaked and flooded apartments, and that a clogged disposal went unrepaired. Reviewer also reports a nearly $600 increase offered at renewal.

title: Tenant alleges unsecured buildings, needles on grounds and advertised pool closed for years
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges building doors lacked working locks so people slept in stairwells, packages were frequently stolen, and residents found used needles on the grounds. Reviewer also alleges the advertised pool had been inoperable for years and that management repeatedly reminded tenants it was not obligated to salt icy lots and steps.

title: Tenant alleges six-month dishwasher repair delay that hid a leaking pipe
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges stagnant water sat in the dishwasher for over six months despite repeated requests, and that when repairs finally occurred a burst pipe was found slowly leaking into the kitchen cabinet. Reviewer also alleges tenant safety was disregarded.

title: Tenant alleges nearly three months' rent in charges for early move-out plus unused service fees
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after five months they were charged nearly three months' rent to leave early, combining a two-month termination fee and an 'insufficient notice fee', while also paying for pest control that did not stop roaches and a valet trash service no one used.

title: Former tenants allege abusive post-move-out collection calls from Greystar accounting
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewers in two separate posts allege that an employee in Greystar's corporate accounting/collections department repeatedly called former tenants after move-out, shouting and using what they describe as illegal tactics, and urged others to file complaints with the BBB and the D.C. Attorney General.

title: Tenant alleges repeated appliance failures, unauthorized entry and ignored theft reports at Tustin complex
subject: greystar
bob-faith
summary: Reviewer alleges appliances failed repeatedly after a management change in 2013, that staff entered her apartment without 24-hour notice, and that thefts she reported to management, a regional supervisor, and Greystar's CEO were never investigated. Reviewer also alleges she had to buy her own dryer after management refused to replace a failing unit.

title: Tenants say Greystar's check for a mold small-claims judgment was returned unpaid
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewers allege they won a small-claims case against Greystar/Bay Street Apartments for furniture damage and evacuation costs caused by ongoing water intrusion and mold, but that Greystar delayed payment and then stopped payment on its settlement check, which was returned. They report receiving a replacement check about three months after the ruling.

title: Former Riverstone tenant alleges withheld deposit, late move-out statement and collections referral
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after an agreed early lease termination, Riverstone Residential stopped communicating, sent the move-out statement after the 14-day legal window, kept the full deposit plus additional charges, and referred the account to collections without first attempting to collect.

title: Tenant alleges management threatens residents who complain at Gateway Lakes
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges management responds to complaints mainly by threatening residents, failed to act on threats from neighbors, charged for valet trash service that was not provided, and advertised a gated community that was not gated. Reviewer also reports an ant infestation and a unit that differed from the model shown.

title: Tenant alleges registered car towed as abandoned during paving work
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges their registered vehicle was tagged as abandoned and towed after being moved during confusing repaving notices, and that management defended the tow. Reviewer also alleges the pool gates did not lock, creating a safety hazard. A commenter on the report disputed the reviewer's account.

title: Tenant alleges eviction over $500 fee dispute followed by $7,700 bill
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges Greystar pursued eviction over $500 in legal fees after partly late rent, proceeded with the eviction despite an arranged payment deal with the manager, and then billed $7,700 in early-termination and other charges that went to collections.

title: Family alleges Greystar complex barred next of kin from deceased tenant's apartment
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after a long-term tenant died, management disabled the lock and refused her only next of kin access to retrieve clothing and photos, while allowing cleaners in without notice; access came only after the family obtained a court order. Reviewer further alleges the unit's walls were covered in black mold from a water leak in the unit above.

title: Tenant alleges open security gates amid robberies and poor water service
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the advertised secure gates were left open all day despite several robberies, with management responding only by email asking residents to report suspicious activity. Reviewer also reports very low water pressure, intermittent hot water, and thin walls.

title: Tenant alleges eviction notice over promised rent credit and misstated square footage
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges a promised move-in rent credit was never applied, that an eviction notice was posted while the billing dispute was pending, and that the unit's square footage did not match the floor plan; reviewer says they asked the City of Los Angeles to inspect. Reviewer reports other tenants experienced similar billing errors.

title: Tenant alleges new Greystar management refused partial rent and moved straight to eviction
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges that after a job loss, newly arrived Greystar management refused a partial rent payment and began eviction within weeks while adding daily late fees and attorney fees, despite a year and a half of on-time payments.

title: Riverstone tenant alleges surprise move-out bill and mold-riddled units
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges Riverstone Residential management at a Tualatin complex charged move-out fees tied to incoming tenants, changed move-out dates, and issued a final bill that differed from earlier written figures, and that corporate said it had no grievance process. Reviewer also alleges the units were mold-ridden and that maintenance advised tenants to spray mold with a bleach solution themselves.

title: Denver tenant alleges unaddressed bed bugs and months of broken lighting
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges the buildings were infested with bed bugs and management never notified residents, treating single units so the bugs spread. Reviewer also alleges about a third of parking-lot and stairway lights had been out for nearly a year amid reported vehicle break-ins.

title: Denver tenant alleges unkept repair appointments, infestations and tenants forced out for complaining
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer alleges repair appointments were routinely not kept, the complex became vermin-infested and crime-ridden, and residents who complained about repairs were pushed out. Reviewer alleges the lease makes departing or evicted tenants liable for both sides' attorney fees and that damage from neglected repairs is deducted from deposits.

title: Riverstone tenant alleges lease terms changed mid-lease to add utility charges
subject: greystar
summary: Reviewer, a Desert Storm veteran, alleges that after the complex was sold the new management changed the lease before it expired and added new water, trash and sewer charges billed through a third-party company. Reviewer also alleges inconsistent enforcement of the lease's pet rules.
